cli.md install table omits --openchamber-policy; -y alias accepted by three commands but unlisted.
Missing staged-write.sh returns 127; die() misattributes broken kit to parent-symlink error.
Two unjudgeable probes render as counted verdicts instead of unknown rows (opposite directions).
config.sh status view narrower than menu's 'Current settings' — backend row missing.
browser_bridge_remove noop stub plus unconditional 'WSL browser bridge removed' — claims removal that never happened.
Substring group match, run_q-silenced gpasswd, unconditional 'Removed from group' echo.
note() printf %b interpolates paths — escape sequences in directory names garble the warning.
Four sourced-only sh/ libs deploy 755 vs 644-sourced-lib invariant; carried since 0.0.41d.
Stale docs/design/ references in shipped comments after docs restructure — files/ side of sweep missed.
project_path_sane maintained as two near-identical copies — drift hazard on the security gate.

Header enumerates pre-0.0.29 flat file list; ~40 files deploy via manifest today.
Update trust anchor TLS-only to tracked branch ref — matches documented model, no change requested.
Docs flag tables have no automated pin against actual parsers — claim-drift guarded by review only.
Partial set skeletons across bin/ (set -e xor set -u); traced, no unguarded defect found.
Claimed missing 2>/dev/null on config.sh menu grep — both sites carry it; retracted on verification.
